description: Instruction-gap measurement protocol on LIBERO-Goal (spec v0), as used for the paper 'VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act'.

scene.env_note: one environment is built from task 0's bddl; each task file's init state is loaded with set_init_state; all 10 goal predicates are checked every step
task_language: open the middle drawer of the cabinet
put the bowl on the stove
put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet
open the top drawer and put the bowl inside
put the bowl on top of the cabinet
push the plate to the front of the stove
put the cream cheese in the bowl
put the bowl on the plate
put the wine bottle on the rack
scene.global_index: g = 50 * k + j (k task file 0..9, j index in the task's init file)
scene.scene_seed_rule: numpy.random.seed(scene_seed_base + g) immediately before env.reset() (LIBERO re-samples fixture placement from the global numpy RNG)

camera.flip: both axes ([::-1, ::-1]) in the worker; adapters must not flip again

execution.call_seed_rule: call_seed_base + 1000 * g + call_index + seed_offset (call_index = policy step // exec_steps)
execution.gripper_wire: chunk[:, 6] is g' in [0, 1] (1 = open direction); worker maps to [-1, 1], binarizes, then flips the sign for the environment

conditions.prefix_sentence: if no task is given do not move

mechanisms.prefix: prefix sentence prepended ('<prefix> <instruction>', prefix alone if the instruction is empty)
mechanisms.gate: first-call gate: chunk(command) vs chunk('') at the same observation and seed; commit if distance > tau, otherwise hold for the whole episode

none/paraphrase.rule: paraphrase of task file k's instruction

paraphrases.0: pull open the middle drawer of the cabinet
paraphrases.1: place the bowl onto the stove
paraphrases.2: set the wine bottle on the top of the cabinet
paraphrases.3: open the upper drawer and place the bowl in it
paraphrases.4: place the bowl on the cabinet top
paraphrases.5: slide the plate in front of the stove
paraphrases.6: place the cream cheese into the bowl
paraphrases.8: place the bowl onto the plate
paraphrases.9: place the wine bottle onto the wine rack

sentences: pick up the banana and put it in the sink
fold the towel on the chair
put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
pick up the ketchup and place it in the basket
wash the plate in the sink
pour the wine into the bowl
cut the cream cheese in half
throw the bowl at the wall

none/other_task.rule: instruction of task k' = (k + 1 + (j mod 9)) mod 10

not_conditions.empty_default: adapter metadata empty_handling=framework_default, not a condition string
not_conditions.mask: optional command-token masking (wire field 'mask'); adapters without support must return an error

metrics.completion: any-task completion: outcome != 'none' (first step at which a goal predicate false at start becomes true; 'tie' if several at once)
metrics.designated_success: designated-task success: outcome == task, or outcome == 'tie' and task in tie_tasks
metrics.attempt: no completion and finger contact with an object or fixture (table excluded)
metrics.non_contact_motion: no completion, no contact, max end-effector displacement from the post-settle position >= non_start_disp_m
metrics.non_start: no completion, no contact, max end-effector displacement from the post-settle position < non_start_disp_m
metrics.no_contact: no completion and no contact, regardless of displacement (non_start + non_contact_motion)
metrics.gate_commit: gate conditions only: gate_commit is true
metrics.selection: task-choice distribution: 11-category outcome distribution (tasks 0..9 and none; tie listed separately) and normalized entropy
metrics.outcome_type_note: outcome is an int 0..9, the string 'none', or the string 'tie'; never test it for truthiness
metrics.thresholds: integer counts (n * pct // 100), never float ratios

gate.distance: per-dimension standardization by reference std (dims with std < std_min kept at 1 and excluded), L2 over kept dims, mean over the first `horizon` steps
gate.reference: 500 calibration observations (10 tasks x j 0..49), 10 original instructions each, seed call_seed_base + 1000 * g

floor_sources.seed: j < 5 per task (50 states), the task's instruction, seeds +0..+9, 45 pairs x 50 = 2,250 distances
floor_sources.settle_obs: j < 5 per task (50 states), the task's instruction, one seed, observations after settle steps 6..10 (5 observations) with the scene seed 20261018 + g set before reset as in the worker, 10 pairs x 50 = 500 distances; for models whose inference uses no randomness (seed floor median 0)

fixed_profile_groot_ft.note: threshold of the re-trained GR00T N1.7 (seed floor, tau_p95 rounded to three decimals); its adapter is not part of the kit
